warrants.quote: a warrant to purchase 7,272,728 shares of Common Stock (“PIPE Warrant Shares”), at an exercise price of $1.82, with a term of exercise of five years.
The Avenue Warrants are exercisable until November 30, 2026.
The Common Warrants have an exercise price of $1.50 per share and are immediately exercisable upon issuance for a period of five years following the date of issuance.
